dialogues.jp:
「まあ、来るなとは言われなかったし、別にい
　いよな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I didn't say I was coming, but it should be alright."
dialogues.text: "Well, I didn't say I was coming, but it should be alright."

dialogues.jp:
今日こそは俺の看病｛コスモ／小宇宙｝を爆発させるべく、
白河家へとやって来た。
dialogues.en: Once again, I was visitng Kotori's house to look after her.
dialogues.text: Once again, I was visitng Kotori's house to look after her.

dialogues.jp:
人差し指をピンと立てる。インターホンを押す
指にも力が入るってものだ。
dialogues.en: I press my index finger onto the interphone button.
dialogues.text: I press my index finger onto the interphone button.

dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: --*Ding dong*
dialogues.text: --*Ding dong*

dialogues.jp: 音も違って聞こえるぜ！
dialogues.en: I heard a different sound.
dialogues.text: I heard a different sound.

dialogues.jp: 『はい』
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉だけど」
dialogues.en: "I, it's Asakura."
dialogues.text: "I, it's Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 『あ、朝倉君ですね。ちょっと待ってください』
dialogues.en: "Ah, it's you. Hold on a second."
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's you. Hold on a second."

dialogues.jp:
「…………？　何だか、声が違うような？　ま
　さか、風邪のせいで……？」
dialogues.en:
"......? Her voice sounds different? Don't tell me the
cold's returned..."
dialogues.text:
"......? Her voice sounds different? Don't tell me the
cold's returned..."

dialogues.jp:
ドアが開く。不安は一瞬にして杞憂に終わり、
コスモも一緒にしぼんだ。
dialogues.en:
The door opened. My short moment of anxiety ended once I saw
the face behind the door.
dialogues.text:
The door opened. My short moment of anxiety ended once I saw
the face behind the door.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、みっくんだったのね」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, it's you, Mik-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, it's you, Mik-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「お見舞い、ですよね？」
dialogues.en: "You're visiting Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "You're visiting Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「お邪魔虫はさっさと退散しようと思ったんで
　すけど……ちょっと、事態が紛糾しちゃいま
　して」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm, Tomo-chan and I would normally leave now if that's the
case... but the situation's a bit more complicated."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm, Tomo-chan and I would normally leave now if that's the
case... but the situation's a bit more complicated."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何、それ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? What did you say?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What did you say?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、上がってください」
dialogues.en: "In any case, come upstairs."
dialogues.text: "In any case, come upstairs."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いらっしゃい。朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Welcome, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Welcome, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「……何で、寝てるの？」
dialogues.en: "...Are you trying to sleep?"
dialogues.text: "...Are you trying to sleep?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって、パジャマ姿は恥ずかしいもん」
dialogues.en: "Letting him see me in my pajamas is embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "Letting him see me in my pajamas is embarassing..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの台詞に、みっくんとともちゃんは、や
れやれと首を振った。
dialogues.en:
At Kotori's line, both Tomo-chan and Mik-kun started shaking
their heads.
dialogues.text:
At Kotori's line, both Tomo-chan and Mik-kun started shaking
their heads.

dialogues.jp:
「何か、事態が紛糾しているとか言ってたんだ
　けど、それって？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, what kind of circumstances were you talking about
earlier?
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, what kind of circumstances were you talking about
earlier?

dialogues.jp:
３人に等分に｛たず／訊｝ねる。と、ともちゃんが、テー
ブルから何かを手に取った。
dialogues.en: I asked the three of them. Tomo-chan pointed to the table.
dialogues.text: I asked the three of them. Tomo-chan pointed to the table.

dialogues.jp: 「それは……服？」
dialogues.en: "That's... clothes?"
dialogues.text: "That's... clothes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんです……これで、ちょっと揉めてま
　して」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... we're sort of arguing about this."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... we're sort of arguing about this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「聞いてくださいよ〜。ふたりともひどいんで
　すよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Listen to me~ These two are horrible~"
dialogues.text: "Listen to me~ These two are horrible~"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ことりがケチンボなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "You're the unhelpful one."
dialogues.text: "You're the unhelpful one."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんな事ないと思うけどなあ……」
dialogues.en: "I don't think that's true..."
dialogues.text: "I don't think that's true..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、きっと、朝倉君なら分かってくれます
　よ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm sure he'll understand."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm sure he'll understand."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、話ってのを聞きましょか」
dialogues.en: "I might, once you tell me what's going on."
dialogues.text: "I might, once you tell me what's going on."

dialogues.jp: 「なるほど……また手芸部か」
dialogues.en: "I see... the handicrafts club again."
dialogues.text: "I see... the handicrafts club again."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうです。まぁた手芸部なんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, the handicrafts club agaaain."
dialogues.text: "Yes, the handicrafts club agaaain."

dialogues.jp:
クリスマスパーティーの時、ミスコンだなんて
いうヌルイ企画を催した、あの、手芸部である。
dialogues.en:
The same handicrafts club that came up with the idea of a
Miss Kazami Academy contest in the first place.
dialogues.text:
The same handicrafts club that came up with the idea of a
Miss Kazami Academy contest in the first place.

dialogues.jp:
「ステージ衣装を貸してやるから、コンテスト
　に出場しろ……ねえ」
dialogues.en:
"So they lent you a costume, and want you to participate in
the contest using it...?"
dialogues.text:
"So they lent you a costume, and want you to participate in
the contest using it...?"

dialogues.jp:
「なにか、借金の｛かた／形｝に娘を差し出せ、みたいな
　話だな」
dialogues.en:
"In other words, they basically want to advertise their
handiwork..."
dialogues.text:
"In other words, they basically want to advertise their
handiwork..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そう、朝倉君もそう思いますよねえ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, that's what I think too."
dialogues.text: "Yes, that's what I think too."

dialogues.jp: 我が意を得たりと、ことりが笑う。
dialogues.en: Kotori smiled, finding an ally.
dialogues.text: Kotori smiled, finding an ally.

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「そんな、人聞きの悪い。いいじゃないですか、
　減る物じゃないんだから」
dialogues.en:
"They've not been very popular lately, so they need this to
increase it."
dialogues.text:
"They've not been very popular lately, so they need this to
increase it."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「……ま、その点はノーコメントという事で」
dialogues.en: "...No comment."
dialogues.text: "...No comment."

dialogues.jp:
逃げを打ちつつ、テーブルの服を改めて見遣る。
それは、見るからに浮世離れしたドレスだ。
dialogues.en:
Running away from the argument, I looked over the dress,
from the previous Christmas. It seemed to be from the Edo
period.
dialogues.text:
Running away from the argument, I looked over the dress,
from the previous Christmas. It seemed to be from the Edo
period.

dialogues.jp:
浮世離れってのは、別の言葉で言えば、祭り向
きって事だ。
dialogues.en:
Or to it say it another way, it's one of those dresses you'd
find worn in festivals.
dialogues.text:
Or to it say it another way, it's one of those dresses you'd
find worn in festivals.

dialogues.jp:
そしてもちろん、卒業パーティーってのは、風
見学園のひとつの祭りだった。
dialogues.en: Basically, specially made for the a party.
dialogues.text: Basically, specially made for the a party.

dialogues.jp:
学生服姿のボーカリストってのも、確かに、締
まらないかもしれないな……。
dialogues.en:
I guess it might be more fitting for a vocalist than a
school uniform...
dialogues.text:
I guess it might be more fitting for a vocalist than a
school uniform...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ふたりとも、私に内緒で勝手に約束しちゃう
　んだもの……ひどいなあ」
dialogues.en:
"These two promised on my behalf without even telling me...
they're horrible."
dialogues.text:
"These two promised on my behalf without even telling me...
they're horrible."

dialogues.jp:
苦笑混じりに呟く。そうでなくとも、ことりに
は、クリスマスの時の記憶があるのだろう。
dialogues.en:
A bitter smile was mixed with her words. No doubt she was
remembering what happened last Christmas.
dialogues.text:
A bitter smile was mixed with her words. No doubt she was
remembering what happened last Christmas.

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp:
「でもぉ、３人分用意してくれるからって。お
　得でしょ？　だから……」
dialogues.en:
"But a lot of people worked hard on this. And you gain
something as well, right?..."
dialogues.text:
"But a lot of people worked hard on this. And you gain
something as well, right?..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、コンテストに出るのは私だし……」
dialogues.en: "But why choose me for the contest..."
dialogues.text: "But why choose me for the contest..."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、ほら、そこはアレ、ことりって人気あ
　るから」
dialogues.en: "Well, you are just the most popular girl in school..."
dialogues.text: "Well, you are just the most popular girl in school..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うう、もてる女はツライっすな」
dialogues.en: "Being popular isn't a bed of roses, you know."
dialogues.text: "Being popular isn't a bed of roses, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「もてないよりはツラクないって」
dialogues.en: "Certainly no worse than being treated badly."
dialogues.text: "Certainly no worse than being treated badly."

dialogues.jp:
みっくんがぱたぱたと手を振る。ことりはくすっ
と笑った。
dialogues.en:
Mik-kun clapped her hands together, and Kotori suddenly had
an uncharacteristically evil smile on her face.
dialogues.text:
Mik-kun clapped her hands together, and Kotori suddenly had
an uncharacteristically evil smile on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな事言って、お兄ちゃんさん以外には、
　興味なんてないんでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
Speaking of that, how has your beloved brother been treating
you lately?"
dialogues.text:
Speaking of that, how has your beloved brother been treating
you lately?"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「うえ？　や、やだなあ、これまた人聞きの悪
　い……」
dialogues.en: "Wahh? D, don't start talking about that..."
dialogues.text: "Wahh? D, don't start talking about that..."

dialogues.jp: 何やら、身につまされる話やね。
dialogues.en: I don't think I want to know what's going on.
dialogues.text: I don't think I want to know what's going on.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、朝倉君。どうしましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-kun. What do you think?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-kun. What do you think?"

dialogues.jp:
テーブルとことりとに何度か視線を往復させて、
俺は言った。
dialogues.en: Looking at the table and at Kotori a few times, I said.
dialogues.text: Looking at the table and at Kotori a few times, I said.

dialogues.jp: 「……いいんじゃないかな、と俺は思うけど」
dialogues.en: "...Doesn't sound too bad to me."
dialogues.text: "...Doesn't sound too bad to me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う……マジですか」
dialogues.en: "Uu... you're serious?"
dialogues.text: "Uu... you're serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「てか、その服って、着てみるとどんな感じな
　の？　あんまり変だったら、そりゃ、止した
　方がいいと思うけど」
dialogues.en:
"There's no harm in at least trying it, right? If you really
don't like it, you can just stop."
dialogues.text:
"There's no harm in at least trying it, right? If you really
don't like it, you can just stop."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ことり、朝倉君に見せてあげれば？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, why not let Asakura-kun see it on you?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori, why not let Asakura-kun see it on you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う？　だ、駄目っすよ、そんな。恥ずかしい」
dialogues.en: "Wha? I, I can't, that's embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "Wha? I, I can't, that's embarassing..."

dialogues.jp:
よよよ、と毛布を引っ張り上げると、顔を隠し
てしまった。
dialogues.en: She pulled the blankets over her head to hide her face.
dialogues.text: She pulled the blankets over her head to hide her face.

dialogues.jp: 「……スケスケシースルーとか？」
dialogues.en: "...Is it a sexy see-through?"
dialogues.text: "...Is it a sexy see-through?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……私を学園の勇者にして、どうするんです
　か」
dialogues.en: "...What should the heroine of the school do now..."
dialogues.text: "...What should the heroine of the school do now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、確かに。新聞報道されるレベルだな」
dialogues.en: "I bet the newspapers would have stories about it even."
dialogues.text: "I bet the newspapers would have stories about it even."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふう……分かりました。分かりましたよぅ」
dialogues.en: "Huu... I got it, I got it."
dialogues.text: "Huu... I got it, I got it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「コンテストには、出る事にします。……私ひ
　とりが｛ひとみごくう／人身御供｝となれば良いのよね。あふん
　……」
dialogues.en:
"I'd enter the contest, and be the human sacrifice for you
guys."
dialogues.text:
"I'd enter the contest, and be the human sacrifice for you
guys."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとね、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Thanks, Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Thanks, Kotori!"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「うんうん、それでこそ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, thank you!"

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり３人は仲がいいんだろう。紛糾してい
た｛・・・／らしい｝事態は、笑顔に収束した。
dialogues.en:
Those three really are close. Even after an argument (...of
sorts), they still ended with smiles all around.
dialogues.text:
Those three really are close. Even after an argument (...of
sorts), they still ended with smiles all around.

dialogues.jp:
（手芸部が用意した衣装か……。どんなんだろ
　うな？）
dialogues.en:
"(The dress the handicraft club is preparing... I wonder how
it'd look on her?)"
dialogues.text:
"(The dress the handicraft club is preparing... I wonder how
it'd look on her?)"

dialogues.jp:
明後日がぐっと楽しみになってしまう俺であっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I'd be able to find out and enjoy the day after tomorrow,
apparently.
dialogues.text:
I'd be able to find out and enjoy the day after tomorrow,
apparently.

dialogues.jp:
その後、お茶なんぞを飲んだりして、楽しい時
間を過ごした。
dialogues.en:
After that, we drank some tea and chatted the rest of the
day away.
dialogues.text:
After that, we drank some tea and chatted the rest of the
day away.

dialogues.jp: 結局また、看病もへったくれもなかったな……。
dialogues.en: In the end, there was no real reason to come today either...
dialogues.text: In the end, there was no real reason to come today either...

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの看病２◆
dialogues.en: ◆Looking After Kotori 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆Looking After Kotori 2◆

dialogues.jp:
看病｛コスモ／小宇宙｝を爆発させるべく、再び白河家へと
やって来た俺。
dialogues.en: Once again, I returned to the home of the Shirakawas.
dialogues.text: Once again, I returned to the home of the Shirakawas.

dialogues.jp: しかし、先客が居た。ともちゃんとみっくんだ。
dialogues.en:
However, there were visitors ahead of me: Mik-kun and
Tomo-chan.
dialogues.text:
However, there were visitors ahead of me: Mik-kun and
Tomo-chan.

dialogues.jp:
彼女たちは、卒業パーティーについて相談して
いたらしい。つまり、手芸部から餌としてちら
つかされたドレスをどうするか、だ。
dialogues.en:
The three of them were discussing about the graduation
party. Apparently the handicraft club was using the dress as
bait for Kotori to advertise it.
dialogues.text:
The three of them were discussing about the graduation
party. Apparently the handicraft club was using the dress as
bait for Kotori to advertise it.

dialogues.jp:
何だかんだで、結局ことりは手芸部のコンテス
トに出る事に決まり、ドレスがゲット出来る事
になったのだった。
dialogues.en:
In the end, Kotori decided to participate in the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest after all.
dialogues.text:
In the end, Kotori decided to participate in the Miss Kazami
Academy Contest after all.
